readout_other: pole test; rotarod; c-Fos and TH immunohistochemistry; Western blot; electron microscopy of PSD
direction_notes: Holographic US of the bilateral dorsal striatum increased c-Fos-positive cells in the DS (not in M1) and improved pole and rotarod performance and TH-positive neuron counts in MPTP mice.
safety_notes: Mechanical index 0.5 and Ispta 180 mW/cm2 below FDA limits; H&E and Nissl staining showed no tissue damage or neural loss in healthy mice.

exposures.label: Holographic US to bilateral dorsal striatum

timing.protocol_description: 3 MHz, PRF 500 Hz, DC 20%, tone-burst duration 0.4 ms, sonication duration 1 s, interstimulus interval 4 s; 30 min (c-Fos) or 20 min per day for 10 days (treatment).
